teams.title: Start by creating teams & workers
teams.text: Create operational teams, add workers and assign a team leader. Link teams to categories so tasks always reach the right team. Workers sign in with their name and a chosen icon. Teams and workers can also be uploaded via bulk import (CSV/Excel).

categories.title: Start by creating categories
categories.text: Go to locations and units and add categories to group units (e.g. drills, sanitary, fitness equipment, office, electricity). Categories help with filtering and organising units and depend on the company's sector. By linking worker teams to specific categories, WinProx ensures tasks are carried out by the correct team. Add locations (sites, buildings, floors) and create units per location — these are the assets, machines or rooms where issues and tasks are registered. You can also import units per location via CSV or Excel (or create them in bulk).

clock_point.title: Create a Clock Point
clock_point.text: With the Time module, workers sign in and clock in/out via a Clock Point. Create at least one clock point and print the QR sticker so your team can get started.

clock_point_facility.title: Print the Clock Point QR code
clock_point_facility.text: Workers sign in via a Clock Point QR code. Open the button on Users and print the QR so your team can sign in.
